acceptanceCriteria.statement: The legacy set is named before anything is extracted: every world-engine feature the LOD lab no longer exercises is listed by name, with the evidence that it is unused, so it can be excluded from the extraction instead of carried into the shared pipeline as dead weight.

verifyVia.input: Run the legacy-set scan over src/worldengine/** and planet-lod-lab.html's applyDrivers.
verifyVia.observable: A committed list of unused features, each with its evidence (no lab call site / no reachable driver / master pinned inert). Every entry is reproducible by a command, not asserted. The list is non-empty or the scan proves the set is genuinely empty.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: applyDrivers's driver logic is converted into PACKS that both front-ends apply, and the lab's local applyDrivers shrinks to a thin caller over them — so the lab and the game run the same driver code. ⛔ NOT a wholesale move of the 828 lines: that plan was killed on measured evidence (AC2-refutation.md). The destination is packs because packs are already the contracted thing both front-ends share.

verifyVia.input: Resolve the lab's and the game's import closures, and count the driver logic still local to planet-lod-lab.html.
verifyVia.observable: Each converted block is a registered pack in the runtime PACKS array, imported by BOTH front-ends; the lab's applyDrivers no longer computes it locally. tests/one-pipeline-fence.test.js registration 2 shows the debt ledger SHRINKING, never growing.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each conversion changes no pixels AND breaks no gate. ⛔ THE GATE LIST IS THE CORRECTION THE REFUTATION FORCED: the killed plan's acceptance was a state-value diff, which is structurally blind to the citation fence and to fences that pin literal lab bytes. A criterion that cannot fail is not a criterion.

verifyVia.input: At each conversion commit run: port-uniform-delta:check, port-uniform-delta:citations, the Instrument A membership diff, and the fence suites (radius-live-feed, vis-scale, src-boundary, lab-surface-ratchet, one-pipeline).
verifyVia.observable: Instrument C ZERO delta exit 0 · citations exit 0 with CHECKED not falling · Instrument A shows no NEWLY RED · all fence suites green. ⚠ planet-lod-lab.html carries 175 line-anchored citations inside 1933-2760 and 500 at or past 1933, so ANY line movement there is a citation event, not a free edit.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A new pack CANNOT ship without the lab importing it — the import-back rule is a gate that fails by name with the offending path, not a convention that rots. This is the half that stops the bleeding: the rule already existed in prose and was dropped for seven consecutive packs.

verifyVia.input: Add a deliberately-broken control pack that the lab does not import, and run the fence.
verifyVia.observable: tests/one-pipeline-fence.test.js fails by name with the offending module path in the message, and the debt ledger's shrink-only ceiling refuses to grow. Restoring the import returns it to green.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Wiring the NEXT lab feature is demonstrably not a hand reconciliation of two routes — proven by converting one block to a pack end to end and recording what it actually cost.

verifyVia.input: Wire one previously-unwired lab feature from the queue-(a) set through the shared driver path.
verifyVia.observable: The feature renders on a generated body in the running game, and the change touches the shared module plus its registration only — no second, game-side reconciliation of the same law.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The lab still works. The extraction moves the lab's own driver path out from under it, so the lab authoring surface must behave exactly as before — this is the regression that would be easiest to miss and most expensive to discover later.

verifyVia.input: Load planet-lod-lab.html, drive its controls, and re-run the Step-5 shrink-only ratchet.
verifyVia.observable: tests/lab-surface-ratchet.test.js green; the lab renders and its controls move the same uniforms they moved before.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Max looks at the lab and the game side by side and judges that they now read as ONE pipeline with two front-ends rather than two things kept in step by hand.

verifyVia.input: Max drives the lab and the live game on the same seed after the extraction lands.
verifyVia.observable: Max's holistic acceptance that the connection is real and that the next lab feature will not cost a month.
